<head-word>סְתַר</head-word>
<language-key> ch.,</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Pa.</italic> סַתֵּר same, 
<italic>to hide</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. מְסַתַּר. Targ. Is. LXV, 16. Targ. Jer. XVI, 17 (ed. Wil. מִסַתְּרָן, corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִסְתַּתַּר, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיסְּתַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to hide one’s self; to find shelter</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Koh. VII, 12.—*Targ. Y. I Deut. XXIX, 5 מִסְתְּרָא וכ' finding shelter in your schools.—Ber. 31
<sup>b</sup> כיון דמִסְתַּתַּרְנָא when I closet myself (with a stranger), v. preced. Sot. 2
<sup>b</sup> זמנין דלא אִיסְתַּתְּרָא ואמר איסתתרא (not איסתתר) it may happen that she did not closet herself with a man, but he (the husband) says that she did &c. Ib. ומִסְתַּתְּרָא וליכא וכ' Rashi (ed. ומיסתתרה) and she may closet herself, and we have in our days no waters … to test her &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O01713">
<head-word>סָתַר</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= סחתר, Saf.</definition>
<notes> of חתר; cmp. Arab. 
<italic>šatar</italic>) [
<italic>to dig under</italic>,] </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to upset, tear down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 31
<sup>b</sup> אם אמרו לך זקנים סְתוֹר וכ' if the old tell thee, tear down, and the young, build, tear down and build not, v. סְתִירָה II; Ned. 40
<sup>a</sup>. Sabb. VII, 2 הבונה והסוֹתֵר he who builds (on the Sabbath) or who tears down. Yoma 10
<sup>a</sup> שיפלו בונין ביד סוֹתְרִין that the builders (of the Temple, the Persians) should fall through the hands of the destroyers (the Romans), v. סָתוֹרָא. Ab. d’R. N. ch. VI סְתָרוֹ ועקרו וכ' he dug under it (the rock) and broke it loose &c. Koh. R. to VII, 26 כותל קשה … וסוֹתְרוֹ a wall is strong, but man has more power and tears it down; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to stir up</italic>,] 
<italic>to loosen, unravel</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. I, 5 סותר את שערה the priest loosens her hair (Num. V, 18 ופרע); אם … לא היה סוֹתְרוֹ if her hair was beautiful, he did not loosen it. Treat. S’maḥ.ch. ch. VIII סוֹתְרִים שערות וכ' you may untie the hair of dead brides; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dissolve, decompose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥănina 1) (ref. to Prov. XXV, 20) כזה … וסוֹתְרוֹ כך היו סוֹתְרִים וכ' as one pours vinegar on natron and decomposes it, so they decomposed (counteracted) the words of the Law; v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to undo, reverse, invalidate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. III, 8 כל זמן … סותר את הדין whenever he offers new evidence, he reverses the decision, i.e. the court has to try his case again; לאחר שלשים יום אינו סותר after thirty days, the judgment cannot be disturbed.—Esp. 
<italic>to make void the days of a Nazarite’s vow which have been observed, to begin anew</italic>. Naz. II, 10 סותר שבעים he must count seventy days again. Ib. III, 3 ס' את הכל he must count over the whole period (of days); אינו ס' אלא שבעה he has to count only seven days over. Tosef. ib. II, 13 יש לו לִסְתּוֹר סותר וכ' if there is a portion of the period left to undo, i.e., if the period of his vow has not yet expired, he must count thirty days again; כל … ואין לו לסתור סותר וכ' whenever he becomes unclean on a day on which it is improper to offer a sacrifice, and he has nothing left to undo, i.e. his term has expired, and he lacks only a sacrifice to be released: he must count seven days; a. fr.—5 (logics) 
<italic>to contradict, disprove</italic>. Succ. 26
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מעשה לסתור, v. מַעֲשֶׂה. Sabb. 13
<sup>b</sup> שאלמלא … שהיו דבריו סוֹתְרִין וכ' but for him, the Book of Ezekiel would have been expunged from the canon, because its words seemed to contradict the words of the Law. Ib. 30
<sup>a</sup> לא דייך שדבריך סותרין וכ' not only do thy words contradict those of David, but they contradict one another; a. fr.—Num. R. s. 13 לא אחד מהן סותר על חבירו neither of them conflicts with the other.—[Yalk. Ex. 356 שלא יסתרו, v. סָרַס I 
<italic>Hithpa.</italic>]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְתַּתֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be disarranged, be undone</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kil. IX, end, 32
<sup>d</sup>; Y. Sabb. XIII, beg. 14
<sup>a</sup> מִיסְתַּתֵּר הוא the web will go apart again, opp. מתקיים.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<head-word>סֵתֶר</head-word>

<language-reference>
<xref rid="O01712"> סָתַר I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>secrecy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. I, 2 (2
<sup>a</sup>) נכנסה עמו לבית הס' (not בס') if she went with him to a closeted place, v. סְתִירָה. Gen. R. s. 45 סִיתְרָהּ, v. גָּלוּי.—בַּסֵּ' 
<italic>in secret</italic>. B. Bath. 9
<sup>b</sup> גדול העושה צדקה בס' וכ' he that dispenses charity in secret, is greater than Moses. Ḥag. 16
<sup>a</sup> העובר עבירה בס' וכ' he who selects a secret place for committing a sin, is considered as though he pushed away the feet of the Divine Presence (denying the omniscience of God). Ab. IV, 4; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. סְתָרִים,</plural-form> constr. סִתְרֵי, סִי'. Mikv. IX, 3; Lev. R. s. 15, a. fr. בית הס' covered parts of the body, posteriors &c. Meg. 3
<sup>a</sup> מי הוא זה שגילה סְתָרַיי וכ' who is he that revealed my secrets to men? Ib. אני … סְתָרֶיךָ I did reveal thy secrets. Ḥag. 11
<sup>b</sup> סתרי עריות the secrets of the laws of incest, i.e. the laws not explicitly stated (cmp. סְתָם). Y. Keth. V, 29
<sup>d</sup> bot. סיתרי תורה the secrets of the Law, i.e. logical deductions; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<plural-form>Pl. עָבִים, עָבִין; עָבוֹת</plural-form>. Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 11 אלו הן הע' these are the thick (heavy) garments; Kel. XXVIII, 8; Y. Sabb. II, 4
<sup>d</sup> bot. הע' הרכים the thick but soft garments. Mikv. VIII, 3 טפין ע' thick (turbid) drops; a. fr.—[Y. Kil. V, beg. 29
<sup>d</sup> היו עבות, ed. Krot. העבות, R. S. to Kil. V, 1 היו עבים, read: הֶעֱבוּ, v. עָבָה.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00013">
<head-word>עָבַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to work</italic>] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to serve, work for.</italic></definition>
<notes> Gitt. IV, 5 עוֹבֵד את רבו וכ' works one day for his master, and one for himself; a. fr. Esp. 
<italic>to do priestly service</italic>. Ḥull. 24
<sup>b</sup> אחיו הכהנים … לַעֲבוֹד וכ' his brother priests allow him not to serve, until he is twenty years of age.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prepare; to till the ground; to dress</italic> (hides).</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 22 קין עובד אדמה Cain the tiller of the ground. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>b</sup> bot. גוי עוֹבְדָן; Tosef. ib. IV (V), 10 עוֹבְדוֹ, v. דָּבַב I; (Bab. ib. 33
<sup>a</sup> עיבדן). Y. Sabb. I, 4
<sup>b</sup> top נתן כלים … ומצאו עובד בו וכ' if one gave a gentile garments to wash, and found him working at them on the Sabbath; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> עָבוּד, 
<plural-form>pl. עֲבוּדִין</plural-form>
<italic>dressed</italic>, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="P00026">עֲבוֹדָה</xref>) 
<italic>to use esp. for idolatrous purposes; to worship</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tem. VI, 1, v. infra. Ab. Zar. III, 7 (defining אשרה) כל שעוֹבְדִין אותה a tree which is itself worshipped (not one at which idolatrous rites are performed). Ib. הואיל … הן עובדין since they worship merely the image (under the tree). Snh. VII, 6 העובד ע"ז אחד העובד וכ' he who worships an idol, whether he goes through the regular forms of that particular worship (v. ib. 60
<sup>b</sup>), or sacrifices &c. Ab. Zar. III, 5 העכומ"ז העובדין וכ' as to idolaters that worship mountains and hills (as deities), they (the territories) may be used, but what is on them is forbidden. Ib. 45
<sup>b</sup> אילן … ולבסוף עֲבָדוֹ if one planted a tree and afterwards made it a subject of worship. Ib. 46
<sup>a</sup> ועוֹבְדֵיהֶן בסייף and those (Jews) who worship them are put to death by the sword; Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 8. Sabb. 56
<sup>b</sup> אילמלי לא … ולא עָבְדוּ ישראל ע"א had David not listened to evil gossip (against Mephibosheth), … Israel would not have worshipped idols (under Jeroboam). Ib. 105
<sup>b</sup> עד שיאמר לו עֲבוֹד ע"ז until he (the tempter) finally tells him, worship idols; Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 31. Ḥull. 13
<sup>b</sup> נכרים שבח"ל לאו עוֹבְדֵי ע"א הן gentiles outside of Palestine must not be considered as idolaters; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>

<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>service, agricultural implements, working cattle</italic> &c. Gen. R. s. 42 (ref. to אָכְלָם, Gen. XIV, 11) זו ע' this means their agricultural service.</definition>
<notes> this means their agricultural service.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>manual labor; servitude, service</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>divine service, priest’s service; worship</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kidd. I, 59
<sup>d</sup> top וייפסל מן הע' and he (the priest) will be made unfit for service. Tosef. Shek. III, 26; Ḥull. 24
<sup>a</sup> כ"ה ללמוד ושלשים לע' twenty-five years is the age for apprenticeship, and thirty years for practical service. Ib. הע' בכתף the service of carrying the Tabernacle on the shoulder. Men. l. c. אלמדך סדר ע' I will teach thee the order of the priestly service. Yoma 32
<sup>a</sup> המשנה מע' לע' he who goes from one function of the Temple service to another. Ib. עבודת היום בבגדי וכ' the special service of the Day of Atonement is performed in white garments. Ib. 39
<sup>b</sup> הגרלה לאו ע' היא casting lots is no special function. Ib. III, 3 אין אדם נכנס לעזרה לע' וכ' no one must enter the Temple court for worship, unless &c. Snh. VII, 6 (60
<sup>b</sup>) זו היא עֲבוֹדָתוֹ (not עבודתה) this is the form of worshipping that deity; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>the emoluments of the officiating priest</italic>. B. Kam. 109

<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Deut. XI, 13) איזו היא ע' שבלב … זו תפלה what is meant by the service of the heart? Prayer. Arakh. 11
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXVIII, 47) איזו היא ע' … זה שירה what is the service in joy and cheerfulness of the heart? It is song. Ib. (ref. to Num. IV, 47) איזו היא ע' שצריכה ע' וכ' what service is that which requires (accompanies) sacrificial service? It is song; a. fr.—הָעֲ' 
<italic>by the worship!</italic>, for ‘by God!’ Yeb. 32
<sup>b</sup>. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 2, ch. IV; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>‘Ăbodah</italic>, 
<italic>the first of the last three sections of the Prayer of Benedictions</italic> (תְּפִלָּה), containing 
<italic>the prayer for the restoration of the Temple service</italic>. Ber. 29
<sup>b</sup> טעה … בע' חוזר לע' if he failed to insert the prayer for the New Moon Day in the ʻĂbodah, he must begin the ʻĂ. anew; נזכר בהודאה חוזר לע' if he recalls the omission while reading the Hodaah (the second of the last three sections), he must begin &c. Y. ib. IV, 8
<sup>a</sup> bot. כל דבר שהוא לַבָּא אומרה בע' whatever prayer refers to the future is inserted in the ‘A.—Meg. 18

<sense>
<number>—5)</number>

<sup>a</sup>) העובד עכ"ום את מי עבד וכ' (Mish. ed. העובד כוכבים וכ') in the case of one accused of idolatry, (the witnesses are asked,) whom (what special deity) did he worship? and in what manner did he worship? Ab. Zar. 11

<entry id="P00059">
<head-word>עָבַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be thick, swell; to run over.</italic></definition>
<notes> Par. VI, 4 כדי שׁיַעַבְרוּ המים וכ' that the water may overflow into a vessel; a. e.—Ex. R. s. 15 שאני עוֹבֵר, v. עֶבְרָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. סְגֵי I a. II) 
<italic>to pass, to cross</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sot. VIII, 1; Sot. 33
<sup>b</sup> כיצד עָבְרוּ ישראל את וכ' in what manner did the Israelites cross the Jordan? Cant. R. to V, 13 עוֹבֵר הוא וחוזר וכ' he goes over his studies once and again &c.; a. fr.—ע' את הדין 
<italic>to cross the line of justice, to be too severe.</italic> Midd. II, 2 כאילו עברו עליו וכ' as if they had treated him too severely (arbitrarily). Ex. R. s. 30 כשם שאני יכול לַעֲבוֹר … ואני איני מַעֲבִיר וכ' as I (the Lord) have power to treat the nations with rigor, but refrain from doing so, so shall you not go beyond the line of justice. Ib. עִיבְּרָה את הדין (
<italic>Pi.</italic>); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (with על) 
<italic>to pass over</italic> (a sin); 
<italic>to forgive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to V, 5 (play on מור עובר, ib.) מר עובר ע' על מררי the bitterness passes away, he (the Lord) passes over my bitterness (sin). R. Hash. 17
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Mic. VII, 18) למי נושא עון למי שעובר על פשע whose iniquity does he pardon? the iniquity of him who forgives (his neighbor’s) transgression; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to transgress, sin</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 86
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. כיון שע' אדם עבירה ושנה וכ' as soon as a man has committed a sin and repeated it, it becomes to him a permitted act. Ib.
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. ע' על עשה when one has transgressed a positive law (committed a sin of omission). Ib. ע' על כריתות וכ' when one has committed sins punishable with extinction or death by a court. Erub. 100
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. עובר על בל וכ', v. בַּל. Keth. VII, 6 העוֹבֶרֶת על דת וכ' if a wife offends against Mosaic or Jewish customs, v. דַּת; Y. ib. VII, 31
<sup>c</sup> top נשים המְעַבְּרוֹת על הדת (
<italic>Pi.</italic>); a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pass, overtake, precede</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 7
<sup>b</sup> כל המצות מברך עליהן עובר לעשייתן in the performance of all religious ceremonies one must say the benediction over them before doing them; מאי משמע דהאי עובר לישנא דאקדומי היא what evidence is there that this 
<italic>‘ober</italic> has the meaning of precedence? Answ. by ref. to ויעבר (II Sam. XVIII, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to pass by, go away, be removed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. III, 1 אלו עוֹבְרִין בפסח the following things must pass away (their use must be suspended) during Passover. Bets. 26
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מום עובר a transitory blemish, opp. קבוע. Ber. 26
<sup>a</sup> ע' יומו בטל קרבנו when its day is passed, the sacrifice of the day is void. Pes. II, 2 חמץ … שע' עליו הפסח leavened matter … over which Passover has passed (which had been in the house during Passover). Ber. IX, 3 הצועק לַשֶּׁעָבַר וכ' praying for what is passed (decided) is a vain prayer, e.g. if one’s wife is with child, and one prays, may it be the will of God that my wife bear a male child; Y. Taan. II, 65
<sup>c</sup> bot. נותן הודייה לשעבר וצועק וכ' one gives thanks for what is passed, and prays for what is to come. Gitt. VII, 7 כל זמן שאֱעֶבוֹר מכנגד פניך וכ' as soon as I shall have been out of thy sight for thirty days; Tosef. ib. VII (V), 10. Keth. 17
<sup>a</sup> ע' מלפני כלה he passed aside to make room for a bridal procession. Yoma 66
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. חטאת שעָבְרָה שנתה a sin-offering whose year is passed (that is older than one year); Tem. 22
<sup>a</sup> שעִיבְּרָה שנתה (Pi.) whose year is completed (v. infra). Ib. 21
<sup>b</sup> בכור שעברה שנתו a first-born animal older than one year; R. Hash. 5
<sup>b</sup>; Zeb. 29
<sup>a</sup> bot. שעיברה; Tosef. Snh. III, 6 בכור שעיברה זמנו ed. Zuck. (read with Var.: שעבר). Keth. 87
<sup>a</sup> על שֶׁעָ' as regards the past, v. עָתִיד; a. v. fr.—לַשֶּׁעָ' 
<italic>in former days</italic>. Gen. R. s. 47, opp. עַכְשָׁיו; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶעֱבִיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lead past, stroke gently</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 23 [read:] מַעֲבִירִין על גבי העין בשבת you are permitted to stroke a sore eye on the Sabbath; Y. ib. XIV, 14
<sup>c</sup> bot. מעבירין על העין. Ib. הֶעֱבִירוּ עליו כלים they passed garments over it.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to pass; to remove, displace</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 17
<sup>a</sup> מַעֲבִירִין את המת מלפני כלה וכ' a funeral procession is made to make way for a bridal procession, and both of them for the king, v. supra. Gitt. 57
<sup>b</sup> שאין אנו מעבירין אותו באל אחר that we shall never displace him for another god; שאין מַעֲבִיר אותנו וכ' that 
<pgbrk id="pg1039" />he will never displace us for another nation. Ex. R. s. 30 כאילו היא מעביר איקינין וכ' as if he removed (defaced) the king’s portrait; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go beyond</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. איני מעביר וכ', v. supra. Ib. הבריות מעבירין על הדין וכ' men go beyond the line of justice (are treacherous, cruel), and they are punished; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to skip over; to forego, postpone</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—ה' על מדותיו, v. מִדָּה.—Yoma 33
<sup>a</sup>; 58
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. אין מעבירין על המצות you must not forego the occasion for performing a religious act. Erub. 64
<sup>b</sup> אין מעבירין על האוכלין you must not pass by eatables (and let them lie in the street); B. Mets. 23
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to forego, overlook, pardon</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 17
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Mic. VII, 18) מעביר ראשון ראשין וכך היא המדה (Ms. M. על ראשון וכ'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he pardons one sin after the other (before they are put on the scale), and such is the divine dealing. Ib. מעבירין לו על כל פשעיו all his transgressions are pardoned; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to forego</italic> or 
<italic>disregard</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 41
<sup>b</sup> שלשה דברים מעבירין … על וכ' three things make a man disregard his own sense (of right) and the sense of his Maker; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עִיבֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be completed, full</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tem. 22
<sup>a</sup>, a. e., v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to transgress repeatedly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. VII, 31
<sup>c</sup> top, v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go beyond</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. l. c. עיברה את הדין, v. supra. [Tosef. B. Kam. VI, 22 שעיברה הדליקה עד, read with Y. ib. VII, 5
<sup>c</sup>. שעברה … את.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="P00181">עוּבָּר</xref>) 
<italic>to carry, be with young</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 31
<sup>b</sup> כי עִבַּרְתּוֹ אמו וכ' while his mother was pregnant with him, his father died. Tosef. B. Kam. X, 1 ועִיבְּרָה אצלו (B. Kam. IX, 1 ונִתְעַבְּרָה) and the cow became pregnant while she was in his possession. Ḥull. 58
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> f. מְעוּבֶּרֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעוּבָּרוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>pregnant</italic>. Yeb. XVI, 1. Ib. 36
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. מע' חבירו a woman who is with child of another man (divorced or widowed during pregnancy). Gen. R. s. 85 מלכים אני מע' גואלים אני מע' I am pregnant with kings, with redeemers (kings and redeemers are destined to be of my offspring). Yeb. III, 10; a. fr.—4) (v. עִיבּוּר) 
<italic>to extend the city limits</italic>, for the purpose of defining Sabbath distances, in cases of buildings projecting beyond the city lines (outskirts). Erub. V, 1 כיצד מְעַבְּרִין וכ' (v. אָבַר), defined ib. 53
<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. V, beg. 22
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Ber. VII, 12
<sup>c</sup> top כאשה עוברה like a pregnant woman; Tosef. ib. VI (V), 1; a. e.—6) 
<italic>to complement, add to</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to intercalate a month</italic>, (second Adar); 
<italic>proclaim a leap year; to complement a month</italic> (v. מָלֵא) 
<italic>by assigning to it an additional day</italic> (thirty days). Tosef. Snh. II, 1 שנים אומרים צריכה לְעַבֵּר if two judges say, it is necessary to intercalate a month. Ib. 2 על שלשה סימנים מעברין וכ' on three indications the intercalation is decided; על שנים מעברין וכ' when two of them exist, the intercalation is decreed. Ib. ואם עִיבְּרוּהָ הרי זו מעוברת but if they proclaimed it a leap-year, it remains a leap-year; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְעוּבָּר; f. מְעוּבֶּרֶת. R. Hash. 19
<sup>b</sup> אלול מע' an Elul of thirty days. Snh. 11
<sup>b</sup> אינה מע' the year is not a leap-year (the declared intercalation is invalid); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְעַבֵּר, </binyan-form>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to swell</italic> (with anger), 
<italic>to become wroth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Num. 135 (expl. ויתעבר, Deut. III, 26) כאדם שאומר נ' בי פלוני נתמלא וכ' as a man says, that man (became full) got wroth with me, meaning, he was filled with wrath against me; Yalk. Deut. 818; Sifré Deut. 29 כאשה שאינה יכולה לשוח מפני עוברה (
<italic>swelled</italic>,) like a woman that cannot bend down on account of the child she is pregnant with; v. עֶבְרָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become pregnant</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 45 מביאה … נִתְעַבְּרָה she conceived on her first intercourse; אין אשה מִתְעַבֶּרֶת וכ' no woman conceives on &c.; Yeb. 34
<sup>a</sup>. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> כדי שלא תִתְעַבֵּר וכ' that she may not become with child, and her beauty &c., v. כָּחַשׁ. B. Kam. IX, 1 ונתעברה אצלו, v. supra; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be extended, to be consolidated into one township</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Erub. V, 22
<sup>b</sup> bot. יכול אני … בית מעון מתעברת וכ' I can cause Beth Ma‘on and Tiberias to be considered one township (as regards Sabbath distances).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be added to, to be proclaimed a full month</italic> (of thirty days), 
<italic>a leap-year</italic> (of thirteen months).</definition>
<notes> Y. R. Hash. III, beg. 58
<sup>c</sup> ניסן לא נ' מימיו Nisan was never made a full month (by decree of the court); Y. Shebi. X, beg. 39
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.—Snh. 12
<sup>a</sup> ראויה … שתִּתְעַבֵּר that year ought to have been a leap-year. B. Mets. נִתְעַבְּרָה השנה נתע' לשוכר if the year was made a leap-year, the tenant (that rented by the year) reaps the benefit of the intercalation. R. Hash. 19
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (with עֲבֵרָה) 
<italic>to be committed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. B. Kam. X, 3 בהמה ונֶעֶבְרָה בה עבירה if one stole a beast, and some sinful act was committed on it (by which it became forbidden for any benefit); (B. Kam. IX, 2, a. fr. נעבדה … עבירה).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to pass, cross, step over, forgive</italic> &c. (v.

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be with child, to conceive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LI, 7 עַבְּרַת (ed. Lag. עברית, Bxt. עֲבָרַת, corr. acc.). Targ. Y. Num. XI, 12 (ed. Vien. עֲבָרִית, corr. acc.); a. fr.—Part. pass. f. מְעַבְּרָא, מְעַבְּרָה, מְעַבַּרְתָּא;

<definition> as preced.

<sup>b</sup> מְעַבֵּר להו מעברא he passed them over the ford. Yoma 33
<sup>b</sup> עַבּוּרֵי דרעא וכ', v. דְּרָעָא. Erub. 65

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become pregnant</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="P00153">
<head-word>עָדַן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to turn</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="P00198">עוּד</xref>,] 
<italic>to be round, smooth, pliant</italic>.</definition>
<notes>
<italic>Pi.</italic> עִידֵּן </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make pliant; to bend</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 16
<sup>b</sup> (play on עדינו, II Sam. XXIII, 8) כשהיה … היה מְעַדֵּן עצמו וכ' when sitting and studying the Law, he made himself pliant like a worm, opp. מקשה עצמו stiffening one’s self.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to smooth, lubricate, to improve</italic> (the complexion); 
<italic>to refresh, invigorate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to I, 2 מה שמן מְעַדֵּן … מְעַדְּנִים וכ' as oil brightens the appearance of the head and the body, so the words of the Law &c. Pes. 43
<sup>a</sup> משיר … ומעדן את הבשר makes the hair fall out and improves the complexion. Y. Ber. VI, 10
<sup>b</sup> top אשר … מעדנים לעַדֵּן בהן וכ' who created all sorts of delicacies to refresh therewith the soul &c. Gen. R. s. 16 עִדְּנוֹ מכל אילני וכ' he nursed him (with fruits) of all the trees of the garden of Eden; ib. לעַדְּנוֹ וכ' he had intended to nurse him &c. Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup> מרחצאות לעַדֵּן בהן עצמן (Ms. M. לֵעָרֵן בהן; Yalk. Ms. להִתְעַדֵּן, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) (the Romans have erected baths) for their own enjoyment (not for the benefit of the people); Ab. Zar. 2
<sup>b</sup>; Yalk. Is. 316. Sifré Deut. 306 כל זמן … היו מערבים ומעדנים ומפנקים וכ' as long as my son does my will, humor him, nurse him and indulge him and give him to eat and to drink; Yalk. Deut. 942 היו מְעַדְּנִין וכ'. Sifré l. c. מה רביבים … ומעדנים וכ' as the rains come down on the plants and brighten them and embellish them &c.; Yalk. l. c; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> מְעוּדָּן a) 
<italic>well-nursed, graceful</italic>. Y. Ned. IX, end, 41
<sup>c</sup> (ref. to 
<pgbrk id="pg1045" />II Sam. I, 24) אין תכשיט … גוף מע' ornamentation becomes only a well-nursed (graceful) body.—b) 
<italic>indulged, used to luxuries</italic>. Mekh. Mishp. s. 8 אם היה מרוכך מע' מפונק if the wounded man was delicately reared, used to comfort and luxuries; Yalk. Ex. 339.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶעֱדִין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to surround, bind, connect</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 10 (ref. to Job XXXVIII, 31 מעדנות וכ') כימה מַעֲדֶנֶת וכ' the Kimah binds (gives substance and shape to) the fruits; cmp. מָזַר.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְעַדֵּן, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְעַדֵּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be made smooth, pliable; to be rejuvenated; to be nursed, recover strength</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 120
<sup>a</sup> נ' הבשר ונתפשטו וכ' the body was again made smooth, the wrinkles of age were straightened out, and beauty returned &c.; Yalk. Ex. 165. Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup>, v. supra. Ned. 8
<sup>b</sup> מִתְעַדְּנִין בה the righteous will be rejuvenated by it (by basking in the sun). Pesik. Haḥod., p. 102
<sup>a</sup> יִתְעַדֵּן בני וכ' let my son be nursed with food and drink for two or three months; יִתְעַדְּנוּ בני וכ' let my children be nursed &c.; Cant. R. to II, 5; Koh. R. to III, 11; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Is. 357; a. fr.—Tosef. Eduy. III, 2 נוחרין היו עֲדָרוֹת וכ' they stabbed entire herds in the camp. (v., however, עָרוֹד).—מִגְדַּל עֵדֶר (b. h.) pr. n. pl. 
<italic>Migdal Eder</italic> (Fold Tower), between Bethlehem and Jerusalem. Shek. VII, 4; Kidd. 55
